triggerSignals: AWS bill growth; egress complaints; margin pressure; renewal window
icp: Digital-native companies with meaningful cloud spend and portable workloads
discoveryQuestions:
Which services drive the bill?
What is the committed-spend term?
Which workloads are portable?
pocStrategy: Run the same workload in the same region with the same user mix.
successMetrics: Total cost; latency; throughput; reliability; migration effort; support
risks: Deep AWS dependencies; no migration window; savings too small
evidenceRequired: Comparable benchmark; full TCO including migration and support

triggerSignals: China HQ or users; Asia launch; cross-border latency; overseas expansion
icp: Gaming, media, SaaS, retail and internet companies operating across North America and Asia
discoveryQuestions:
Where are users and workloads?
Which routes fail?
What are latency and packet-loss baselines?
pocStrategy: Test representative routes and real user traffic.
successMetrics: Latency; packet loss; availability; QoE; deployment time
risks: No meaningful Asia traffic; legal constraints; incumbent meets SLA
evidenceRequired: Route test; regional availability; compliance review

triggerSignals: Multiplayer launch; voice complaints; cheating; live ops growth
icp: Game studios, publishers, MMO/FPS/MOBA developers and global gaming companies
discoveryQuestions:
How many concurrent players?
What voice stack?
Where are cheating incidents rising?
wedgeProduct: GME / TRTC / Anti-Cheat / EdgeOne / CVM / TKE
pocStrategy: Deploy one game, region or feature in a bounded environment.
successMetrics: Concurrency; voice MOS; latency; crash rate; attack metrics
risks: Heavy proprietary integration; long contracts; no test traffic
evidenceRequired: Concurrency benchmark; voice quality; security results

triggerSignals: High video bill; new live product; fragmented vendors; creator growth
icp: Video platforms, creator economy, live commerce, education, OTT and social apps
discoveryQuestions:
Daily volume?
Live or VOD?
Current CDN?
Startup delay?
Buffering rate?
wedgeProduct: VOD / MPS / CSS / TRTC / COS / CDN
pocStrategy: Run the same media workflow and representative traffic.
successMetrics: Startup time; buffering; bitrate; transcode quality; playback success; cost
expansionPath: VOD → Live → RTC → Storage → CDN → AI Media
risks: DRM dependency; proprietary encoding; tightly integrated incumbent
evidenceRequired: Playback benchmark; QoE data; transcode and cost comparison

triggerSignals: Recent attack; bot abuse; multiple edge vendors; WAF complexity
icp: Internet platforms, SaaS, e-commerce, gaming and financial services
discoveryQuestions:
How many edge vendors?
Recent attacks?
False positive rate?
Current WAF?
pocStrategy: Protect one domain and compare effectiveness and latency.
successMetrics: Blocked attacks; false positives; latency; tool reduction
risks: Customized WAF rules; long contracts; unsupported compliance
evidenceRequired: Attack logs; benchmark; SOC validation; latency comparison

triggerSignals: Bilingual AI; RAG; media generation; agent pilots stuck
icp: Enterprises with proprietary knowledge, measurable workflows and an AI sponsor
discoveryQuestions:
Which workflow?
Quality baseline?
Available data?
Who owns governance?
wedgeProduct: Hunyuan / VectorDB / Agent Platform / TI-ONE / OCR / ASR
pocStrategy: Use a bounded workflow and evaluation set.
successMetrics: Task accuracy; latency; cost; governance; time-to-production
risks: No owner; no evaluation set; sensitive data unresolved
evidenceRequired: Evaluation dataset; PoC results; governance sign-off

triggerSignals: GPU shortage; high inference cost; long queues; expiring credits
icp: AI startups, model companies, media generation and large inference users
discoveryQuestions:
Training or inference?
Which GPUs?
Utilization?
Current cost?
pocStrategy: Benchmark same model, batch size and dataset.
successMetrics: Throughput; latency; utilization; cost per task; training time
expansionPath: GPU → Storage → Kubernetes → AI Platform → Security
risks: Framework incompatibility; data gravity; unavailable GPU

triggerSignals: US/Asia expansion; campaign spikes; fraud; slow site; messaging needs
icp: DTC brands, marketplaces, cross-border sellers and retail platforms
discoveryQuestions:
Where are shoppers?
Peak events?
Current CDN?
Fraud issues?
wedgeProduct: CDN / EdgeOne / SMS / Risk Control / COS / CVM
pocStrategy: Test one storefront, campaign or region with real traffic.
successMetrics: Page speed; checkout availability; conversion; fraud reduction; delivery
risks: No cross-border traffic; fully managed third-party platform
evidenceRequired: RUM data; fraud baseline; delivery reports; cost model

triggerSignals: New region launch; Asia customer demand; latency; data residency
icp: B2B SaaS, developer platforms and enterprise software expanding globally
discoveryQuestions:
Which markets?
Where are users?
Required SLA?
Current architecture?
wedgeProduct: CDN / EdgeOne / GAAP / CCN / CVM / TKE / Database
pocStrategy: Deploy one regional workload or path and compare.
successMetrics: Latency; availability; deployment time; support; adoption
risks: No local demand; unsupported residency; application not portable
evidenceRequired: Regional test; architecture and compliance review

triggerSignals: OTT launch; live events; sports rights; archive growth; global distribution
icp: Studios, broadcasters, sports media, OTT, music/video and publishers
discoveryQuestions:
Live, VOD or both?
Audience regions?
Archive size?
DRM?
Concurrency?
